story.title: Obstructive apnea caught before onset
story.watch: Jaw fully forward 38 s before a cluster-first obstructive apnea; 7/8 arousal-linked events covered with 2 advances.

model.pack: no hypnogram-wake (deployable), 1 Hz every cannula-valid second after 600 s lookback
model.fusion: Advance only if fire_now is above threshold (early-warn when pre_onset also high; rescue when active is also high). active-only holds if already advanced. pre_onset without fire_now does not actuate.

controller.fusion: fire_now primary; pre_onset early-warn; active hold/rescue

meta.disclaimer: Untreated PSG: coverage is timing (advance completed before the arousal deadline), not proven event or arousal prevention. Selected example window.
